features: Winner Podium photo count now follows the number of actual winners in each ranked result
Single-person winner displays one photo slot, two-person couple displays two photo slots, and larger supported winner groups display one slot per person
Missing or broken winner photos preserve their allocated position with a neutral blank circular placeholder
Podium photo rows remain centered and stable instead of collapsing when a competitor photo is unavailable
Podium name and country areas use consistent reserved height for better alignment across Top 5 positions
Applies the same behavior to staged Winner Podium and completed Final Ranking because both use the shared live-display renderer
No scoring calculation, results or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
